The podium of the most commented videos in Oceania this week.

Full countdown, from 10 to 1: https://youtu.be/kWYbk4JRIEU

Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, People Aren’t Happy About GTA 6, by SAMTIME, with over 3 thousand comments.
In second place, How to Wrap an Owl, by Owls in Towels, with over 3 thousand comments.
And number one: Is GTA 6 Completely Cooked, by Dolan Darkest, with over 4 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
